skill.name: infsh-cli
skill.description: Use the inference.sh CLI to discover and run cloud AI apps for image, video, LLM, search, audio, 3D, and Twitter/X automation from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.
skill.summary: Discover and run inference.sh cloud AI apps from an AI assistant using infsh commands.
skill.author: tool-belt

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown examples for a CLI skill and were false positives, including API key placeholders, documentation links, shell completion paths, and app command tables. Confirmed risks are the repeated curl-to-shell installer, command-substitution download flow, installation of a downloaded binary into PATH, automatic local file uploads to cloud apps, and Twitter/X automation side effects. No prompt injection attempt or overt malicious instruction was found.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell install commands with reviewed manual installation, pinned checksums, signature verification, and explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: Manual install uses shell command substitution from a remote manifest.
remediation.suggestion: Provide direct per-platform download links or an audited installer that validates manifest data before download.

remediation.issue: Downloaded binary is moved into a user PATH directory.
remediation.suggestion: Explain the install location, verify checksums and signatures before moving the binary, and offer package-manager options.

remediation.issue: Local paths can upload user files to cloud apps.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before commands that send local files, and warn about sensitive directories and private media.

remediation.issue: Twitter/X automation can publish or modify account state.
remediation.suggestion: Require user approval before posting, sending direct messages, following, liking, or retweeting.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both cited sections explicitly say local file paths are automatically uploaded and show media file examples. The capability is intentional, but it is a clear data disclosure risk.

content.user_title: Run Cloud AI Apps with infsh
content.value_statement: Choosing the right inference.sh app and command can slow down AI workflows. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code concise CLI guidance for discovery, authentication, execution, and task tracking.
actual_capabilities: List, search, filter, and inspect inference.sh apps with infsh commands.
Run cloud AI apps with inline JSON or saved input files.
Generate sample input files and retrieve task status or saved outputs.
Explain authentication, API key setup, and CLI update commands.
Describe supported app categories including image, video, LLM, search, audio, 3D, and Twitter/X.
Show local file upload patterns for media inputs.
limitations: Requires the infsh CLI, account access, and network connectivity.
Does not validate third-party app behavior or model output safety.
Local files may be uploaded to cloud services when paths are provided.
Social media actions can publish content through connected accounts.

use_cases.title: Prototype media generation
use_cases.description: Run image, video, audio, and 3D apps from repeatable CLI prompts.

use_cases.title: Compare hosted LLMs
use_cases.description: Find OpenRouter and model apps, generate sample inputs, and track results.

use_cases.title: Automate app operations
use_cases.description: Inspect app schemas, submit long tasks, and retrieve completed outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Find an app
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the infsh skill to find image generation apps. Show the safest command sequence and explain each step briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Run a simple task
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me run {app_name} with a short prompt. Generate a sample input first, then run it and track the task.

prompt_templates.title: Use local media
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an infsh workflow that uses {local_file_path} as input. Warn me before uploading files and explain what will leave my machine.

prompt_templates.title: Build a production workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a repeatable infsh workflow for {goal}. Include app discovery, authentication checks, version pinning, task polling, output saving, and failure handling.

output_examples.input: Find a fast video generation app for a mountain drone shot.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends searching video apps, inspecting google/veo-3-1-fast, generating sample input, submitting the task, and polling by task ID.

output_examples.input: Use a local product photo for upscaling.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for upload confirmation, selects a suitable upscaler, runs the app with the file path, and saves the returned media link.

output_examples.input: Check why my run failed with invalid input.
output_examples.output: The assistant compares the app schema with the provided fields and suggests a corrected input file.

best_practices: Confirm every local file upload before running a command that sends files to inference.sh.
Use app detail and sample commands before running unfamiliar apps.
Pin app versions for repeatable workflows when production output matters.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote install scripts to a shell without reviewing the script or using manual installation.
Do not store real API keys in prompts, shared files, or conversation history.
Do not automate social media actions without human approval of the final content.

faq.question: Does this skill install infsh automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands and guidance. Review installer options before running them.

faq.question: Can it run image and video models?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents infsh commands for hosted image, video, audio, LLM, search, 3D, and utility apps.

faq.question: Does it upload local files?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide local paths to apps that accept file inputs. Confirm files before execution.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it post to Twitter or X?
faq.answer: Yes, the skill documents X automation apps. Use explicit approval for any account action.

faq.question: Is an API key required?
faq.answer: Interactive login can authenticate users. INFSH_API_KEY is documented for CI and scripted environments.
